card: Backports eleven merged master PRs (#36230, #36297, #36309, #36312, #36316, #36322, #36324, #36336, #36364, #36365, #36377) to the 32.x release branch for v32.0rc2. Fixes include allowing fee rate estimation to fall back to block policy when mempool data is unavailable, draining callbacks prior to saving fee estimates at shutdown, enabling hardware SHA256 detection in CLI utilities (providing over 2x speedups in key operations), caching descriptor hashes for faster wallet lookups, and avoiding IP discouragement on private broadcast connections. All constituent changes have already been tested and merged into master.
changed_since_previous: Added backports for #36336 (mining log category), #36364 (hardware SHA256 auto-detection in CLI tools), #36365 (fee estimation fallback to block policy and renaming default estimator to 'auto'), and #36377 (BIP 461 doc entry), and bumped the project version to 32.0 RC2.
evidence: Commit 02a7f11038 (#36364): 'Only kernel::Context users selected a hardware SHA256 implementation, so these tools fell back to the generic one. On an M2 Max, grind is ~5x faster and signing 2000 P2PKH inputs with bitcoin-tx ~2.3x.'
Commit 651670dec1 (#36322): 'Shutdown saves and unregisters the fee estimator before draining queued validation callbacks, so a pending block update can be missing from the saved estimates.'
Commit 635745539f (#36365): 'When the mempool policy estimator cannot produce an estimate, GetFeeRateEstimate() now returns the block policy estimate rather than an error.'
Commit 8ec0fd46f4 (#36312): 'Keep private broadcast connections outside normal discouragement handling. Misbehaving private broadcast peers are still disconnected.'
problem: The 32.x release branch lacks multiple bug fixes and operational improvements merged to master ahead of release: fee estimation fails outright rather than falling back to block policy when the mempool estimator lacks data, CLI utilities default to slow generic SHA256, node shutdown can drop fee estimation block updates, wallet descriptor lookups repeatedly serialize strings, misbehaving private broadcast connections trigger address-level bans, and OpenRPC argument defaults contain non-literal hints.

risk.why: A faulty backport or merge resolution could cause fee estimation regressions, wallet descriptor lookup issues, or unintended peer disconnection behavior in the 32.0 release.

scope_notes: A multi-commit backport branch PR containing 24 commits across 43 files spanning fee estimation, wallet internals, P2P networking, CLI tools, logging, CI, and build release configuration.
summary: Backports eleven pull requests merged on master to the 32.x branch for the 32.0 release candidate (v32.0rc2). The backported changes improve fee estimator fallback and handling on mempool load failure, enable hardware SHA256 auto-detection in standalone CLI utilities, drain validation callbacks before saving fee estimates at shutdown, speed up wallet descriptor lookups, isolate private broadcast connections from IP discouragement, add a dedicated mining log category, fix OpenRPC default hints, and update CI and documentation.
